title: fix(spec): os migrate meta --stored lists a stored dashboard that repeats a global filter key
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Q9LPDdsTEU57RNskLB3jba)_
Fixes #29212

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os migrate meta --stored` 现在会列出「同一个看板里两个全局筛选器用了同一个 key」的已存数据行；另加一个测试钉住保存接口在三种模式下都拒收这种看板。
- 为什么改：#29023 已让保存接口拒收这种看板，但升级前的存量预览不报它，运维升级前看不到哪些看板下次保存会被拒。
- 风险与回滚：只读检测加测试，任何入口的接受/拒收结果都不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.ts`（新 detector，调用同一个判定函数）、`packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.test.ts`、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.dashboard-duplicate-global-filter-name-refusal.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/conversions/refused-shapes.test.ts`，预期 83 个测试全过，其中 #29212 三条。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Stored listing.** `REFUSED_STORED_SHAPES` gains `dashboardDuplicateGlobalFilterName` (id `ui-dashboard-global-filter-duplicate-name-refused`, the #29023 D3 entry of step 18). It walks `stack.dashboards[]` and calls `duplicateGlobalFilterNames` from `ui/duplicate-global-filter-names.ts`, the refinement's own predicate; no logic is copied. One TODO per repeated key, at `dashboards[i].globalFilters[j].name` (or `.field` when the second declaration has no `name`), which is the site the parse refuses. `from` carries the key and the indexes only. The reason leads with the fate (no lossless rewrite, loads with `_diagnostics.valid: false`, next save refused 422) and ends with the predicate's own message.
- **Save-door pin** (test-only in `packages/metadata-protocol`). `saveMetaItem({ type: 'dashboard', … })` with two filters named `r` answers `422 INVALID_METADATA`, one `custom` issue at `globalFilters.1.name`, and stores nothing, with no mode, `mode: 'publish'` and `mode: 'draft'`; a distinct-name control saves in each mode. The harness is the object sibling's (`protocol.object-duplicate-action-name-refusal.test.ts`), copied.
- **Ledger.** `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` gains the new file's three pinned rows (`delete`, `findOne`, `update`), written by `check-engine-double-contract.mjs --write`. Not a forced test edit; it is the gate's own recipe for a new pinned double.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/29212-dashboard-duplicate-filter-stored-listing.md`, `@objectstack/spec` patch.

No forced test edit: the only existing assertion touched is the refused-shape roster pin in `refused-shapes.test.ts`, which names each registered id by design ("A new entry is a reviewed edit").

## Tests

- `refused-shapes.test.ts` gains three cases under `#29212`: the card shape (two filters named `r`) gives one TODO at `dashboards[0].globalFilters[1].name` with the key, both indexes and the predicate's message, the row unrewritten, and the parse still refusing the same site; a key that falls back to `field` (three entries, `region` twice unnamed plus one named `region`) is listed once at `.field` with indexes `[0, 1, 2]`, as the parse locates it; distinct keys and distinct names over one `field` are not listed and the parse accepts them. The roster pin names the new id.
- New `protocol.dashboard-duplicate-global-filter-name-refusal.test.ts`: 6 cases (refusal + control, in each of no mode, `publish`, `draft`), 6 passed.
- Ablation (fix committed first; `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` on the registry line `  dashboardDuplicateGlobalFilterName,`): Tests 3 failed | 80 passed (83), the roster pin and the two listing cases red, the not-listed control green; restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The spec suite imports `./refused-shapes.js` from source, so no dist was involved. Two earlier attempts with `--replacement` were refused by the script as no-ops (the replacement text already occurred), so they mutated nothing.

<details><summary>Package readings at head 0b17ca15 (after merging main)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 791 passed (791), Tests 23394 passed | 1 todo (23395).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: Test Files 304 passed | 4 skipped (308), Tests 22142 passed | 26 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit src/commands/migrate/meta.report-order.test.ts` (the `migrate meta` report over stored dashboards): 21 passed. No CLI test lists refused-shape ids; the rest of the CLI suite is left to CI.
- Before the merge, at `b057b3f2`: spec typecheck exit 0, metadata-protocol typecheck exit 0, the same suites green (spec 23394, metadata-protocol 22133).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Premise re-measured on `origin/main` @ `5a2bdf9c` with the spec dist built: `applyConversionsToStoredItem('dashboard', row, { onTodo })` for a row with two filters named `r` handed 0 TODOs; the control, an object with two actions named `a`, handed 1 (`object-duplicate-action-name-refused`). `premise_still_valid: true`.
- The D3 entry's `acceptanceCriteria` (`18.ui-dashboard-global-filter-duplicate-name-refused.ts`) does not yet say the row is listed, unlike its object sibling's. Still true as written, so it is left alone: it sits outside the claimed file surface.
- No `domain:server` claim holds a `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.*duplicate*` file: the 23 open `pm:dispatched` `domain:server` cards were read, and none names one (#25467 is the move-only `protocol.ts` split, not a test file).
- `duplicate-global-filter-names.ts` and `dashboard.zod.ts` are untouched (sibling #29213). If #29213 changes the predicate's return shape, this detector follows it on a main merge.
- Not listed here: the sibling's second refusal (an entry keyed `dateRange` beside a declared `dateRange`, PR #29370, still a draft when this PR opened). Its stored-row listing goes to the seat as a follow-up and is not built ahead of the predicate it would call.
